g.text: Fixed sample of 262 KldB4 occupations (85 ISCO3 groups). Social-insurance employment, including part-time and apprentices.
Only three observed snapshots. No four-quarter moving average or long-pre-period event study is available. June 2022 = 0; not November 2022.
DDD intervals cluster by ISCO3. March-versus-June seasonality and crosswalk selection limit inference. No causal AI-displacement claim.
